text:
The heart is the organ that pumps blood.

The melody haunted every character's story, a lingering reminder of the lullaby that once brought them peace. It appeared in the most unexpected places—a whistler in the street, a distant radio, the chime of a bell. The motif of the melody tied their stories together, underscoring the shared experiences that knit the fabric of the community. Just as the heart beats with a rhythmic persistence to sustain life, the melody pulsed through the narrative, a steady, vital rhythm connecting disparate souls. It was the circulatory system of their collective memory, carrying the warmth of the past through the veins of the present, ensuring that no one was ever truly alone in the silence.
